purpose: Freeze the exact rational quadratic lower-bound kernel requested by GRF-01 elimination step C, after GRF-03 showed the norm-residue congruence alone is automatic.

mathematical_kernel.ambient: V=H^perp tensor Q with positive-definite form Q=-G|H^perp
rank_preprocessing: Row-reduce the augmented matrix [A|b] exactly over Q.
If a row [0 ... 0 | nonzero] occurs, the affine system is empty.
Otherwise retain the nonzero A-rows as A0 with matching rhs b0; A0 has full row rank and defines the same affine solution set.
mathematical_kernel.emptiness_rule: If rho>B_g(d), then no rational solution satisfying A*v=b can satisfy N=v^T*Q*v<=B_g(d); hence no integral completion exists.
mathematical_kernel.empty_constraint_case: If there are no independent affine constraints, rho=0 and v_star=0.
mathematical_kernel.affine_family_extension: When b=b(u) is affine-linear in rational family parameters u and A,Q are fixed, rho(u)=b(u)^T*S^{-1}*b(u) is an exact rational quadratic form.

lane178_must_supply_before_any_populatio: concrete source-locked affine constraint matrix A and rhs b(u)
proof that every target completion satisfies the chosen affine constraints
exact comparison rho(u)>B_g(d) on that target domain
subset certificate and overlap/accounting against current authority

next_route.main: Only strengthen the symbolic global obstruction if a genuinely new MAIN-owned constraint family is identified; do not enumerate FULL178.
next_route.lane178: Instantiate this kernel only after a source-locked semantic adapter provides A,b(u), target membership, and accounting.
